title: Uncounted amounts: singular partitive
focus: Use singular partitive after paljon or vähän when talking about an uncounted amount.

exercises.explanation: With paljon or vähän, an uncounted substance or amount takes singular partitive. Keep maito and add -a: maito + a = maitoa.
